goal: Restore the real class, specialization, talent and equipment icons in the WeChat mini-program by publishing the prepared runtime-media release to a readable immutable project-owned origin, making candidate verification fail closed when that release manifest is unreadable, and preserving the publishing path for future art assets.
userValue: Players can recognize professions, specializations, talents and equipment from their real artwork instead of generic placeholders, while future releases cannot be marked ready when the configured icon origin returns 404.
nonGoals: Do not redesign the accepted page geometry, top bars, cards or navigation behavior.
Do not claim that static.chickenbro.cloud COS promotion is complete while Tencent Cloud MFA still blocks that promotion.
Do not trigger asynchronous data sync or backfill jobs.
Do not merge before the final WeChat candidate is manually checked for all three icon families.

currentTruth.observedFailure: The previously configured static.chickenbro.cloud runtime-media release manifest and Frost specialization icon both returned HTTP 404, so runtime-media URL rewriting converted trusted upstream icons into missing images.

mustChange: Publish the complete prepared runtime-media release under an immutable project-owned /wow-media/releases/<release-id> path.
Build the WeChat candidate with that readable immutable runtime-media root.
Make the release package verifier read the runtime-media release manifest and reject missing or unreadable roots.
Keep the Lighthouse deployment configuration capable of serving immutable runtime-media releases after future deploys.
Record the verified release identity, counts, public verification command and pending COS promotion boundary in current project state and the publishing runbook.
mustNotChange: Previously accepted top-safe-area evidence and archived release packets.
Route layout geometry, navigation state, backend facts, database contents and scheduled synchronization behavior.
The existing immutable application asset release.
riskUnknown: The public files and package gate can pass while a real WeChat client still exposes a route-specific rendering or domain-policy failure; manual verification remains required.
Promotion from the verified API origin to static.chickenbro.cloud remains pending Tencent Cloud MFA.
evidenceRequired: Full public release-manifest verification of every declared runtime-media file and SHA-256 hash.
Release package verification against the exact backend, app-asset and runtime-media roots.
Targeted tests, typecheck, lint, Taro test suite and UI architecture audit on the final branch head.
Manual WeChat verification that class/spec, talent and equipment icons render as real artwork instead of placeholders.

engineeringHealth.reason: The correction removes reliance on an unpublished root, verifies the whole immutable release, and makes future package readiness depend on a readable release manifest.

acceptanceEvidence: npm run verify:ui-package:release with the verified API, asset and runtime-media roots
Fresh WeChat candidate verification of builds_home_class_spec_icons, talent_simulator_talent_icons and gear_detail_equipment_icons

decisionLog.decision: Public checks proved the configured static.chickenbro.cloud runtime-media manifest and Frost icon returned 404; the missing artwork was therefore a publication failure, not a card-layout defect.
Reuse the already prepared and hash-verified 3,413-file release, publish it atomically to the known Lighthouse origin, and keep COS promotion explicitly pending until Tencent Cloud MFA is available.
Keep this runtime-media correction in a new task-scoped packet because the earlier top-safe-area task and its acceptance evidence are already merged and archived.
